definitions.ga4_dimension: landingPagePlusQueryString (path normalized; query stripped); date for client filter
definitions.content_scope: paradigmlife.net paths classified as content (blog/guides/evergreen); learn/academy included when first/last URL and non-noise; thank-you/portal/paid-LP noise excluded from table
caveats: learn.paradigmlife.net (paid ad landers) and academy.paradigmlife.net (LMS) are excluded from this board.
HubSpot MCP exposes first + last URL only — mid-funnel content views are invisible.
GA4 sessions ≠ HubSpot contacts; do not equate page sessions with MQL counts.
Paid MQLs (PAID_SOCIAL / PAID_SEARCH / PAID_OTHER / PAID_VIDEO) are excluded from Organic MQLs and from content-attributed counts.
Summary organic sessions/users come from complete GA4 channel×day totals. Page table rows are truncated by GA4 thresholding (esp. Direct long-tail); channel totals remain complete.
AI Assistant / Organic Video page-level daily rows were omitted (tiny volume); their sessions still count in summary via channel totals.
Most MQLs in recent windows are paid social → learn.paradigmlife.net form LPs — organic content→MQL may be sparse.
Date filter re-aggregates in the browser from cached daily/contact records — no live GA4/HubSpot calls.
